newsitem.title: USA: Mountasia to issue shares in potential deal.
newsitem.headline: Mountasia to issue shares in potential deal.

text.p: Mountasia Entertainment International Inc said it would issue between 10.6 million and 11.4 million common shares if it exercised its right to require MEI Holdings LP to make a $22.7 million investment in the company.
Mountasia incorrectly stated in a December 27 news release that it would issue between 9.6 million and 10.4 million shares, the company said.
The company said it would only exercise its right to issue the shares under special circumstances. MEI Holdings is Mountasia's largest shareholder.
The company did not elaborate and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
Mountasia said on December 27 it may take as much as a $15.7 million charge to its fourth quarter to close or sell some of its parks.
